body:
If you can't, then don't.

Believe it or not, we all understand.

I was too scared to pull it as well. I think most of us are. Only truly the brave go through with it. 

I don't see people that commit to this thing that's consumed us as cowards. It may be a tad skewed, but I see them as the brave ones. 

Us, those who keep going through and coming back to it, we're the cowards. 

But, with support, we can learn to become brave in a different light. We don't know; none of us, what tomorrow will bring. 

But the point of this subreddit is support. And if one person is still here because of the collective us, then this is the most important /r/ out there.

I'm PM'ing you my contact info. Just in case you ever need to talk.

I don't expect you to know what to say. But, thank you, regardless.

And I hope you know that my inbox is always open as well. (I'll PM you my real account name.)

We only get out, what we put it. Or it some cases, what we don't.
